youtube_description:
Jesus's Replies — an imagined reply from Jesus, answered from Scripture.

With Hindi subtitles. Bible verse for when you're too tired to admit it.

He: Jesus... I fell asleep in the office washroom for ten minutes. I told my manager I was on a call. 😮‍💨
He: Third late night this week. I answer emails at 1 a.m. and still say I'm good.
Jesus: You're not good. You're running on other people's approval.
He: If I slow down, someone else takes my place.
Jesus: Your place with Me was never earned by overtime. Even I stepped away to rest.
Jesus: Going home on time isn't quitting. It's trusting.

“He giveth power to the faint; and to them that have no might he increaseth strength.”
Isaiah 40:29 (KJV)
